# Guide Prague

> > A comprehensive travel guide to Prague, Czech Republic, covering historic landmarks, Jewish heritage, practical visitor information, and day trips.

Guide Prague is created by Alena, a licensed Prague guide, offering detailed information about Prague's four historic towns (Old Town, New Town, Lesser Town, Hradčany), the Jewish Quarter (Josefov), and practical travel advice. The site covers major attractions like Prague Castle, Old Town Square, synagogues, and day trips throughout the Czech Republic.

## Key Topics

- Prague Castle
- Old Town Square
- Jewish Quarter (Josefov)
- Synagogues
- Old Jewish Cemetery
- Rabbi Loew
- Wenceslas Square
- Gothic architecture
- Jewish heritage
- Day trips from Prague
- Czech history
- Holocaust memorial
- Charles IV
- Vysehrad
- Czech cuisine

## Major Historic Districts

- [Prague Castle](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/praha/prazsky-hrad): Prague Castle guide: St. Vitus Cathedral, St. George's Basilica, palaces
- [History of Prague Old Town](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/stare-mesto): Old Town history: medieval market, walls, fortifications, Old Town Square
- [Wenceslas Square in the New Town of Prague](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/vaclavske-namesti): Wenceslas Square (former Horse Market): Prague's historic heart & symbol
- [Hradčany - район, где жив дух старой Праги](https://www.guide-prague.org/ru/hradcany): Hradcany district: palaces, Strahov Monastery, Loreta carillon
- [История Нового Города](https://www.guide-prague.org/ru/nove-mesto): New Town founded 1348 by Charles IV: medieval urban planning
- [История Старого города](https://www.guide-prague.org/ru/stare-mesto): Old Town history: medieval market, Prague Castle to Vysehrad route

## Jewish Heritage & Josefov

- [Jewish Quarter](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/zidovske-mesto): Josefov Jewish Quarter history: synagogues, museum, Holocaust memorial
- [Synagogues in the Jewish Quarter](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/synagogy): Six synagogues in Josefov: Old New, High, and Jewish Museum exhibits
- [Old Jewish Cemetery](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/stary-zidovsky-hrbitov): Historic Jewish cemetery in Josefov with Rabbi Loew's grave (14th c.)
- [Синагоги Еврейского квартала](https://www.guide-prague.org/ru/synagogy): Six synagogues: Old New, High, Pinkas, Klaus, Maisel, Jewish Museum

## Churches & Monuments

- [Church of Our Lady before Tyn](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/tynsky-chram): Gothic Church of Our Lady before Tyn with 80m spires by Petr Parler
- [Powder Gate](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/prasna-brana): Gothic Powder Gate (1475): Old Town entrance and historic tower

## Day Trips & Excursions

- [Day Trips](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/day-trips): Day trip options from Prague: towns, castles, nature, Old Town tours
- [Towns](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/day-trips/towns): Day trips to Czech towns: Kutna Hora, Karlovy Vary, Cesky Krumlov
- [Природа](https://www.guide-prague.org/ru/day-trips/nature): Nature day trips: Krkonose mountains, Snezka peak, Czech national parks

## Practical Travel Information

- [How to Exchange Money in Prague](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/exchange-money-in-prague): Currency exchange tips, Czech crown info, ATM advice, and DCC warnings
- [Чешская кухня: что стоит попробовать](https://www.guide-prague.org/ru/what-to-eat-in-prague): Traditional Czech cuisine: knedliky, soups, desserts, beer snacks
- [The Best Souvenirs from the Czech Republic](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/czech-souvenirs): Traditional Czech products, cosmetics, and gift ideas from Prague
- [Where to See Cherry Blossoms and Magnolias in Prague?](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/spring-in-prague): Cherry blossom & magnolia spots: Seminary Garden, Petrin, Mala Strana

- [About Us](https://www.guide-prague.org/en/about-us): About Alena, licensed Prague guide and Guide-Prague.org creator
